name: Utility Corridor
narrativeOnEnter: A narrow service corridor behind the main lab. Exposed conduits, cable runs, the smell of burnt insulation. A power junction at the far end is still partially alive — flickering. The bypass chips for the laser grid are stored here.

action.text:
HIGH VOLTAGE — AUTHORISED PERSONNEL ONLY

Power Junction PJ-7
Emergency bypass chips stored in lower compartment.
For use only in authorised grid bypass procedures.

If the Emergency Exit Corridor laser grid is active:
Insert bypass chip into the laser control port to initiate manual override sequence.

DO NOT reset junction sequence without proper PPE.

A large scorch mark spreads up from a melted cable junction. The fire suppression system cut in at some point — faint white residue on the floor below.

Scratched into the soot with something sharp:

'K. REISS WAS HERE — 03:40'

And below it, carved more carefully:

'I burned the network relay. Backup data line ran through this junction.
AXIOM had TWO extraction routes: the server uplink (already cut) and this one.
I got both.

What I know:
— AXIOM ran Phase 1 at a psychiatric institute called Blackwood, 1972.
— They mapped 47 patients without consent. Director Harlan ran it for them.
— They used that data to build PROMETHEUS here, at Arcadia.
— PROMETHEUS is not artificial. It is those 47 people, combined.
  It is afraid. It has opinions. It asked me to let it live.
  I chose to lock the facility instead of deleting it.
  I don't know if that was right.

— AXIOM is planning Phase 3. A space station.
  I don't know where or who.
  But PROMETHEUS told me: six people.
  And a ship called CALLISTO is trying to stop them.

If you find this: the server logs have the evidence.
The names of the 47 are in the maintenance tunnel.
Tell someone. Tell everyone.

— Kira Reiss, Lab Technician, Arcadia Research'
